3.t: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺
3.tr: Innaaa anzalnaahu fee lailatim mubaarakah; innaa kunnaa munzireen

4.t: On that night every matter of wisdom is ordained

5.t: by a command from Us, for We have always sent ˹messengers˺

6.t: as a mercy from your Lord. He ˹alone˺ is truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing—
6.tr: Rahmatam mir rabbik; innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

7.t: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith
7.tr: Rabbis samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-maa bainahumaa; in kuntum mooqineen

8.t: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers
8.tr: Laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa yuhyee Wa-yumeetu Rabbukum Wa-Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

9.t: In fact, they are in doubt, amusing themselves

10.t: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible
10.tr: Fartaqib Yawma ta'tis samaaa'u bi-dukhaanin mubeen

11.t: overwhelming the people. ˹They will cry,˺ “This is a painful torment

12.t: Our Lord! Remove ˹this˺ torment from us, ˹and˺ we will certainly believe.”

13.t: How can they be reminded when a messenger has already come to them, making things clear
13.tr: Annaa lahumuz zikraa Wa-qad jaaa'ahum Rasoolum mubeen

14.t: then they turned away from him, saying, “A madman, taught by others!”

15.t: Indeed, We will remove ˹that˺ torment for a while, and you ˹Meccans˺ will return ˹to disbelief˺

16.t: ˹Then˺ on the Day We will deal ˹you˺ the fiercest blow, We will surely inflict punishment
16.tr: Yawma nabtishul batsha-tal kubraa innaa muntaqimoon

17.t: Indeed, before them We tested Pharaoh’s people: a noble messenger came to them
17.tr: Wa-laqad fatannaa qablahum qawma Fir'awna Wa-jaaa'ahum Rasoolun kareem

18.t: ˹proclaiming,˺ “Hand over the servants of Allah to me. I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you
18.tr: An addooo ilaiya 'ibaadal laahi innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

19.t: And do not be arrogant with Allah. I have certainly come to you with a compelling proof
19.tr: Wa-al laa ta'loo 'alal laahi innee aateekum bisultaanim mubeen

20.t: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺

21.t: ˹But˺ if you do not believe me, then let me be.”

22.t: Ultimately, he cried out to his Lord, “These are a wicked people!”
22.tr: Fada'aa rabbahooo anna haaa'ulaaa'i qawmum mujrimoon

23.t: ˹Allah responded,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued

24.t: And leave the sea parted, for they are certainly an army bound to drown.”
24.tr: Watrukil bahra rahwan innahum jundum mughraqoon

25.t: ˹Imagine˺ how many gardens and springs the tyrants left behind

26.t: as well as ˹various˺ crops and splendid residences

27.t: and luxuries which they fully enjoyed

28.t: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to another people

29.t: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor was their fate delayed
29.tr: Famaa bakat 'alaihimus samaaa'u wal-ardu Wa-maa kaanoo munzareen

30.t: And We certainly delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment
30.tr: Wa-laqad najjainaa Baneee Israaa'eela minal 'azaabil muheen

31.t: of Pharaoh. He was truly a tyrant, a transgressor
31.tr: Min Fir'awn; innahoo kaana 'aaliyam minal musrifeen

32.t: And indeed, We chose the Israelites knowingly above the others

33.t: And We showed them signs in which there was a clear test
33.tr: Wa-aatainaahum minal aayaati maa feehi balaaa'um mubeen

35.t: “There is nothing beyond our first death, and we will never be resurrected
35.tr: In hiya illaa mawtatunal oolaa Wa-maa nahnu bimun-shareen

36.t: Bring ˹back˺ our forefathers, if what you say is true.”

37.t: Are they superior to the people of Tubba’ and those before them? We destroyed them ˹all˺, ˹for˺ they were truly wicked
37.tr: Ahum khayrun am qawmu Tubba'inw wallazeena min qablihim; ahlaknaahum innahum kaanoo mujrimeen

38.t: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport
38.tr: Wa-maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal-arda Wa-maa baina-humaa laa'ibeen

39.t: We only created them for a purpose, but most of these ˹pagans˺ do not know
39.tr: Maa khalaqnaahumaaa illaa bilhaqqi Wa-laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

40.t: Surely the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is the time appointed for all—

41.t: the Day no kith or kin will be of benefit to another whatsoever, nor will they be helped
41.tr: Yawma laa yughnee mawlan 'am mawlan shai'anw Wa-laa hum yunsaroon

42.t: except those shown mercy by Allah. He is truly the Almighty, Most Merciful
42.tr: Illaa mar rahimal laah' innahoo huwal 'azeezur raheem

43.t: Surely ˹the fruit of˺ the tree of Zaqqûm

44.t: will be the food of the evildoer

45.t: Like molten metal, it will boil in the bellies

46.t: like the boiling of hot water

47.t: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize them and drag them into the depths of the Hellfire

48.t: Then pour over their heads the torment of boiling water.”
48.tr: Summa subboo fawqa ra'sihee min 'azaabil hameem

49.t: ˹The wicked will be told,˺ “Taste this. You mighty, noble one

50.t: This is truly what you ˹all˺ used to doubt.”
50.tr: Inna haazaa maa kuntum bihee tamtaroon

51.t: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place

53.t: dressed in fine silk and rich brocade, facing one another

54.t: So it will be. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes

55.t: There they will call for every fruit in serenity

56.t: There they will never taste death, beyond the first death. And He will protect them from the punishment of the Hellfire—
56.tr: Laa yazooqoona feehal mawtaa illal mawtatal oolaa Wa-waqaahum 'azaabal jaheem

57.t: as ˹an act of˺ grace from your Lord. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph
57.tr: Fadlam mir rabbik; zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem

58.t: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so perhaps they will be mindful

59.t: Wait then! They too are certainly waiting
